metadata.title: BLDR Epoch//01 | Solana developer event, San Francisco
metadata.description: BLDR Epoch//01 is a two-day Solana campus for developers, founders, and AI engineers. San Francisco, March 9–10, 2027. Workshops, live coding, and demos.

about.heading: Built for builders, by builders
about.intro: Solana Builder Epoch//01 brings together ambitious developers, founders, and AI engineers from across the industry to learn, build, connect and explore what’s possible with open infrastructure.

body.one: Across hands-on workshops, live coding, technical deep dives, and demos, you’ll work through real challenges alongside the people building the next generation of technology. Discover new tools, find collaborators, and see how AI, open networks, and programmable money can create new possibilities, whether you’re already building on Solana or just getting started.
body.two: Meet the people building the tools, work through hard problems together, and explore what becomes possible when AI, open infrastructure, and programmable money meet.

street.name: The Street
street.description: Between the two. Tents, food, places to sit and talk.

newToSolana.question: I’ve never built on Solana. Is this for me?
newToSolana.answer: Absolutely. Epoch//01 welcomes developers, founders, and AI engineers exploring Solana for the first time. Come try new tools through hands-on workshops, live coding, and demos.

crypto.question: Do I need to know crypto?
crypto.answer: No crypto background required. Bring your software skills, curiosity, and questions. You’ll meet the engineers behind the tools and many like-minded builders.

ticket.question: How much is a ticket?
ticket.answer: Attendance is by application. You can apply to attend through our <link>registration page</link>.

speak.question: How can I apply to speak?
speak.answer: Speaker applications are not open yet. More information will be shared in the new year.
